_meta.description: Chat with Apple Intelligence, local on-device AI models, Ollama, OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini, and XAI. Private, powerful, and works across all your Apple devices with one-time purchase.
_title: Ari Helper - All-in-One AI Chat for Everyone
apple-intelligence-chat-spotlight.56cd40: Apple Intelligence chat, Spotlight search, a full Shortcuts catalog, and an Apple Watch app
ari-helper-is-built.f17bb6: Ari Helper is built with multiple layers of privacy and security protections to give you full control over your data:
ari-helper-is-designed.8ee226: Ari Helper is designed as a true universal app with complete feature parity across iOS, iPadOS, and macOS. Every feature, every capability, every detail—available on all your Apple devices without compromise.
ari-helper-supports-local.85ee79: Ari Helper supports local on-device models (downloaded via built-in model manager), Ollama models running on your network, OpenAI GPT models, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini, and XAI Grok. Use your own API keys for cloud providers.
ask-any-model-apple.c636ed: Ask any model — Apple Intelligence, a downloaded local model, or any of your cloud providers — analyze documents, generate and edit images, speak responses, run coding tasks, and dispatch work from your iPhone to your Mac. Every action is chainable in Shortcuts.
ask-ari-from-your.e4bb25: Ask Ari from your wrist: dictate or scribble a question and the answer streams in from your paired iPhone, with an optional spoken reply through the watch speaker. An "Ask Ari" complication launches straight into input, and queued questions deliver automatically when your iPhone reconnects.
blaine-miller-all-rights.b327c2: © Blaine Miller. All rights reserved.
can-i-share-conversations.a8722e: Can I share conversations with others?
chat-with-apple-intelligence.614da8: Chat with Apple Intelligence, local on-device models, Ollama, OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini, and XAI—all in one app. Private AI that runs on your device, syncs across iPhone, iPad, and Mac with one-time purchase.
chat-with-apple-s.4444cc: Chat with Apple's on-device intelligence model right inside Ari — no Siri required. Pick "Apple Intelligence" from the model menu and your prompts never leave the device, with automatic fallback to your local model when it isn't available.
chat-with-openai-gpt.e79bfe: Chat with OpenAI GPT, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini, and XAI Grok using your API keys. All major AI providers in one beautiful interface.
confirmation-dialogs-before-sending.f86e: Confirmation dialogs — Before sending prompts to external providers, Ari Helper can present confirmation dialogs so you always have a chance to review what's being sent and to which provider before any data leaves your device.
connect-to-a-draw.6488ed: Connect to a Draw Things server for powerful on-device image generation. Create stunning images with various models without sending your prompts to the cloud.
connect-to-aws-bedrock.e9ebb1: Connect to AWS Bedrock for enterprise-grade AI model access, including full support for FIPS-compliant endpoints and GovCloud instances. Meet the strictest regulatory and security requirements.
connect-to-draw-things.d3ace6: Connect to Draw Things server for on-device image generation. Create amazing images with local models and enjoy them in the built-in gallery slideshow.
connect-to-ollama-on.8160d0: Connect to Ollama on your local network for even more powerful models while keeping everything private. Your conversations, your hardware, your control.
connect-to-ollama-running.e7919e: Connect to Ollama running on your network for access to larger models while maintaining privacy. Use powerful models on your local hardware.
conversations-sync-across-all.80d2f1: Conversations sync across all your Apple devices via iCloud. Start a chat on your iPhone and continue it on your iPad or Mac seamlessly. All your conversation history stays in sync.
dispatch-prompts-from-ios.7a8888: Dispatch prompts from iOS devices to remote Macs or other hardware for heavy processing. Seamless cross-device AI workflows.
does-ari-helper-require.b22f7e: Does Ari Helper require a subscription?
draw-things-is-an.79777f: Draw Things is an on-device image generation app. Connect Ari Helper to a Draw Things server to generate images privately on your device or network. View and enjoy generated images in Ari's built-in gallery slideshow.
encrypt-conversations-behind-biometr.84e: Encrypt conversations behind biometric lock for sensitive chats. Your private conversations stay truly private with device-level security.
encrypted-private-conversations-sens.fe3: Encrypted Private Conversations — Sensitive chats can be encrypted and locked behind biometric authentication (Face ID or Touch ID). Private conversations are encrypted on device, so even if someone has access to your device they cannot read them without your biometric approval.
enforce-fortress-mode-across.ef4d36: Enforce Fortress Mode across your organization with Apple MDM configuration profiles. IT administrators can remotely deploy and manage security policies to ensure all devices comply with data protection standards.
engage-in-agentic-code.ca023f: Engage in agentic code sessions with built-in tools for file editing, web search, shell commands, and full workspace integration.
enjoy-your-generated-images.b7dc89: Enjoy your generated images in the built-in media gallery with slideshow mode. All your AI creations in one beautiful, organized interface.
fortress-mode-lock-down.2900b6: Fortress Mode — Lock down the app to only allow connections to secure, vetted model platforms. When enabled, Ari Helper restricts which providers can be used, ensuring your sensitive prompts are only sent to trusted endpoints. IT administrators can also enforce Fortress Mode across an organization via Apple MDM profiles.
how-does-ari-helper.306a01: How does Ari Helper protect my privacy and security?
is-my-data-private.ac57e0: Is my data private when using local models?
local-models-run-on.575896: Local models run on Apple's MLX neural network framework, optimized for Apple Silicon. Get the best possible performance for on-device AI with hardware-accelerated inference on M-series chips.
lock-down-the-app.654e33: Lock down the app to only allow connections to secure, vetted model platforms. Fortress Mode ensures the utmost data protections for sensitive prompts by restricting access to trusted providers.
no-ari-helper-is.404ca4: No! Ari Helper is a one-time purchase that works on all your Apple devices (iPhone, iPad, Mac). Buy once and use forever—no recurring subscription fees.
on-device-models-run.0ff0d1: On-device models — Run AI models entirely on your device using Apple's MLX framework. Your prompts and responses never leave your device, giving you complete privacy with zero external dependencies.
one-app-for-all.f99817: One app for all your AI needs—local, network, and cloud models
one-time-purchase-works.18bf5e: One-time purchase works on iPhone, iPad, and Mac. No subscription—own it forever across all your Apple devices.
ready-for-ios-27.ee6eee: ✓ Ready for iOS 27 / iPadOS 27 / macOS 27 / watchOS 27
run-ai-models-directly.c2fdeb: Run AI models directly on your device with the built-in model manager. No data leaves your device when using local models—complete privacy for sensitive conversations.
run-ai-models-privately.8651ec: Run AI models privately on your iPhone, iPad, or Mac with the built-in model manager. Download and chat with local models—no internet required.
run-multiple-prompts-in.620bd9: Run multiple prompts in parallel for faster results. Use prompt templates for repeated tasks. Save conversation histories and sync them across all your Apple devices via iCloud.
start-a-conversation-on.c9827d: Start a conversation on your iPhone and continue it seamlessly on your iPad or Mac. Share conversations with friends as beautiful images or HTML files.
what-ai-models-can.762d0d: What AI models can I use with Ari Helper?
whether-you-re-chatting.a805e3: Whether you're chatting with AI on your iPhone during your commute, generating images on your iPad from the couch, or diving deep into conversations on your Mac at the desk, Ari Helper delivers the same powerful, polished experience everywhere. One purchase unlocks it all.
whether-you-re-running.ddec8d: Whether you're running models entirely on device, connecting to a self-hosted Ollama instance on your network, or using a cloud provider — Ari Helper gives you the tools to choose the privacy level that's right for each conversation.
yes-when-using-local.7d1876: Yes! When using local on-device models or Ollama on your network, no data leaves your device or local network. Private mode with biometric lock adds extra security for sensitive conversations.
yes-you-can-share.13d3cb: Yes! You can share conversations as beautiful images or HTML files, perfect for sharing insights, code snippets, or creative content with friends and colleagues.
your-conversations-are-now.0db54e: Your conversations are now searchable from system Spotlight — tap a result to jump straight back in. Mark any conversation Private and it stays out of search entirely, with its media moved into Ari's encrypted store.
